Name: Chest Label Tooltip
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Chest Label Tooltip[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Name chests and hoppers, shown as a tooltip and view their content when hovering them in the world.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50742/50742-1786806552-1133289528.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Label Editor[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Label Editor[/b] - Open any chest or hopper to type a label in the editor at the top of the screen. (only visible if color picker is off)[/*]
[*][b]Save[/b] - Press [color=#b4a7d6]Enter [/color]to save, leave it empty to remove the label.[/*]
[*][b]Max Length[/b] - Configurable character limit for labels.[/*]
[*]Labels are saved instantly, no need to save by ending the day.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]World Tooltip[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Hover Tooltip[/b] - Hover a labeled chest or hopper in the world to see its name as a tooltip.[/*]
[*][b]Placement[/b] - Configurable placement: [color=#b4a7d6]cursor[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]above[/color], or [color=#b4a7d6]below [/color]the chest.[/*]
[*][b]Text Color[/b] - Configurable text color for the tooltip, editor, and toast.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Content Preview[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Hover Preview[/b] - See a container's contents as an inventory-style grid directly in the world, without opening it.[/*]
[*][b]Hotkey[/b] - Hold [color=#b4a7d6]Left Control[/color] while hovering to show the grid, or enable [color=#b4a7d6]always-on[/color] in the config.[/*]
[*][b]Full Layout[/b] - The grid always matches the container's real size: [color=#b4a7d6]12x3[/color] slots for chests and hoppers, [color=#b4a7d6]14x5[/color] for large chests.[/*]
[*][b]Scale[/b] - Configurable grid scale [color=#b4a7d6]0.5[/color] - [color=#b4a7d6]1.5[/color].[/*]
[*][b]Without Labels[/b] - Optionally show the inventory for unlabeled containers too. [color=#8e7cc3](default: on)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Labels are saved per-save and shared across players.[/*]
[*]Farmhands get a full sync on [color=#b4a7d6]join[/color], [color=#b4a7d6]reconnect [/color]and [color=#b4a7d6]every morning[/color].[/*]
[*]Labels follow chests when moved or carried, keyed by a stable chest ID.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47941]Carryable Chests[/url][/size][/b][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
